title.zh: 【WSJ：Bo Hines 任职白宫期间，其持股公司通过 Tether 相关合作获 630 万美元】
title.en: 【WSJ：Bo Hines 任职白宫期间，其持股公司通过 Tether 相关合作获 630 万美元】

current_state.zh: The Wall Street Journal reported that Bo Hines held a stake in consulting firm Nxum, which collected $6.3M from Tether-related partnerships while he was executive director of the White House crypto council pushing the GENIUS Act, including a bid to extend its compliance transition from 18 to 36 months, before he became head of Tether's US operations.
